subject: general
question: The Gupta rulers in India issued a large number of gold coins called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dinaras.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Gupta rulers in India issued a large number of gold coins called **Dinaras.**
 
• The Gupta period is also known as **the Golden Age of Indian history.**
 
• The first famous king of the Gupta dynasty was Ghatotkacha's son **Chandragupta I. **
 
• **Chandragupta I** was succeeded by **Samudragupta** in about 330 A.D.
 
• Samudragupta's successor **Chandragupta II**, also known as **Vikramaditya, **conquered the extensive territories of **Malwa, Gujarat, and Kathiawar.**
 
• **Kalidasa**, the greatest Sanskrit poet, and dramatist prospered during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Chandragupta-I

 
 
• He was a king of the Gupta dynasty
 
• Title- Maharajadhiraja__
 
• He was the grandson of Sri Gupta who is the first known ruler of the Gupta Dynasty
 
• The Allahabad Pillar inscription indicates that Chandragupta I reigned for a long time
 
 
 
• Chandragupta-II
 
 
• He was the son of Samudra Gupta and grandson of Chandragupta I
 
• Title- Vikramaditya
 
• He elevated culture, art, mathematics, philosophy, religion, and astronomy during his reign
 
• He sponsored a circle of poets known as the Nine Gems
 
 
 
• **Kumaragupta-I**
 
 
• He was the son of Chandragupta II and grandson of the Great Samudragupta
 
• He built the world-famous ancient Nalanda University.
 
• Title- Maharajadhiraja, Parama-bhattaraka, and Paramadvaita
 
 
 
• **Samudragupta**
 
 
• He is known as the** 'Napoleon of India' for his conquests.**
 
• His name appears in the Javanese text ‘Tantrikamandaka’
 
• The record of his reign is preserved in the rock pillar of Allahabad, composed by Harisena, the court poet of Samudragupta.
